items.summary: Drupal has announced upcoming critical security releases on November 18 2026 for Drupal core and advises administrators to prepare for immediate deployment. Technical vulnerability details have not yet been publicly disclosed.
items.title: [Advisory] Drupal: Upcoming Critical Security Release Nov. 2026

items.summary: Two critical memory-safety vulnerabilities in NGINX HTTP/2 handling can allow unauthenticated remote code execution on affected servers. Exploitation may enable attackers to steal data, tamper with websites, or disrupt services. The flaws are in NGINX itself and require HTTP/2 to be enabled. The vendor patch includes fixes for other important vulnerabilities.
items.title: [Advisory] F5 NGINX: Critical Unauthenticated HTTP/2 RCE

items.summary: Security updates and technical details are now available for Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938). Calif has demonstrated remote code execution in widely deployed Java applications, including attacks without authentication against Keycloak, Jira, Confluence and Jenkins. Organisations should urgently identify affected deployments and apply security updates or the documented temporary mitigation.
items.title: [Advisory] Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938): Critical Remote Code Execution, Patch Now

items.summary: Attackers have taken remote control of Danfoss AK-SM and AK-SC controllers at hundreds of supermarkets, mostly in France. Most affected units are alleged to be end-of-life models that no longer receive security updates. Some current-generation controllers running outdated firmware were also allegedly compromised. We have been made aware that this attack is relevant besides Food Supply and could affect other sectors, such as healthcare for specialized cooling equipment, we strongly recommend to review if affected devices are in use at your organization and apply recommended mitigations
items.title: [Advisory] Refrigeration Controllers: Attacks Reported in Switzerland and Across Europe

items.summary: A critical set of vulnerabilities, collectively named Able2Shell, has been disclosed in N-able's N-central remote monitoring and management platform, with public proof-of-concept exploits. Successful exploitation can expose credentials, allow rogue administrative access, and achieve root-level command execution on affected hosted and on-premises deployments. N-able has taken hosted environments offline and urged on-premises customers to shut down servers as a precaution.
items.title: [Advisory] N-able N-central: 33 Zero-Days, Cloud Taken Offline

items.summary: Multiple critical vulnerabilities recently fixed in Danfoss AK-SM 800A refrigeration controllers allow unauthenticated remote code execution and complete device takeover. Attackers could disrupt refrigeration, install persistent malicious firmware, or render controllers inoperable.
items.title: [Advisory] Danfoss AK-SM 800A: Multiple Pre-Authentication Remote Code Execution

items.summary: Red Hat has disclosed two critical vulnerabilities in its Quay container registry. One enables attackers to take over registry token signing and read or overwrite private images across all repositories; the other allows a low-privileged user to steal cross-tenant robot account tokens. Patches are available.
items.title: [Advisory] Red Hat Quay: Critical Private Image Access and Overwrite

items.summary: A zero-day exploit has been released that abuses the Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) authentication feature and Windows Defender to allow a local standard user to gain SYSTEM privileges. The exploit code is publicly available and independently tested, but Microsoft has not confirmed the flaw, assigned a CVE, or released a patch. No in-the-wild exploitation has been reported but should be expected.
items.title: [Advisory] Microsoft Windows: CLFS Zero-Day Privilege Escalation (SignDrop)

items.summary: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been disclosed in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway, which could allow attackers to cause unpredictable system behavior, trigger denial-of-service conditions, or access sensitive information. Several flaws are classified as critical and impact instances under default configurations as well as specialized deployments such as Gateway or AAA virtual servers. Citrix has released security updates to address the vulnerabilities across all affected product lines and hybrid architectures.
items.title: [Advisory] Citrix NetScaler: Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities

items.summary: A critical security vulnerability has been disclosed in PTC's Windchill and FlexPLM product lifecycle management software that allows attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely. The flaw stems from the improper deserialization of untrusted data, potentially granting malicious actors deep access to targeted manufacturing and industrial enterprise networks to disrupt processes or exfiltrate proprietary data.
items.title: [Advisory] PTC Windchill and FlexPLM: Critical RCE via Deserialization (CVE-2026-126325)

items.summary: A synchronization flaw in Apache HTTP Server’s HTTP/2 module allows remote, unauthenticated attackers to corrupt heap memory and potentially execute arbitrary code. Compromised web servers may expose hosted applications, adjacent services, and cloud resources to further attack.
items.title: [Advisory] Apache HTTP Server: Unauthenticated HTTP/2 Remote Code Execution (CVE-2026-119618)

items.summary: Microsoft’s November 2026 Patch Tuesday addresses over 1,000 vulnerabilities across its portfolio, including multiple critical pre-authentication remote code execution flaws and one actively exploited Outlook zero-day. The most urgent issues affect Windows Schannel, Windows Search/Exchange integration, and Outlook NTLMv2 hash disclosure. No other vulnerabilities in this release were publicly disclosed or known to be exploited.
items.title: [Advisory] Microsoft Patch Tuesday November 2026

items.summary: SAP has released its November 2026 security patch day updates, addressing multiple critical vulnerabilities across its enterprise software portfolio. The most severe flaws include pre-authentication remote code execution in NetWeaver ICM, Web Dispatcher, and Gateway, as well as an authentication bypass in SAML2 service provider, potentially allowing unauthenticated attackers to fully compromise affected systems.
items.title: [Advisory] SAP: Multiple Critical Pre-Auth RCE Flaws

items.summary: A high-severity use-after-free vulnerability in Google Chrome's XML component is being actively exploited in the wild. Successful exploitation could allow attackers to corrupt memory, crash the browser, or execute arbitrary code when a user views a specially crafted web page. Google has released updates, and users should apply them promptly. The update includes fixes for other vulnerabilities, which are currently not known to be actively exploited.
items.title: [Advisory] Google Chrome: Actively Exploited XML Use-After-Free (CVE-2026-125350)

items.summary: A critical vulnerability has been disclosed affecting OpenSSH on Linux systems that use the musl C standard library with PAM disabled for password authentication, such as Alpine Linux. It allows attackers to bypass password authentication and gain access without knowing the password. The OpenSSH developers place the root cause outside sshd itself, but they have shipped an emergency workaround in OpenSSH because the flaw is exploitable through sshd.
items.title: [Advisory] OpenSSH: Password Authentication Bypass (sshole)

items.summary: SonicWall has disclosed two vulnerabilities in its Global Management System (GMS), a legacy centralized management platform for SonicWall security appliances. GMS has reached End-of-Life, no security patches will be released. The critical flaw lets unauthenticated attackers read internal GMS files and expose sensitive data. The second flaw is a SQL injection that lets authenticated attackers access or modify the GMS database.
items.title: [Advisory] SonicWall GMS (End-of-Life): Unpatched File Read and SQL Injection (CVE-2026-109593, CVE-2026-109594)

items.summary: Barracuda fixed a pre-authentication authorization bypass and a command injection flaw affecting several of its security and networking appliances. When chained together, they could allow an attacker with access to the administrative interface to bypass authorization controls and gain root access to the device.
items.title: Barracuda: Authorization Bypass (CVE-2026-116606) and Command injection (CVE-2026-111560)

items.summary: PHP has announced an upcoming security release addressing two critical vulnerabilities. Public reporting associates these issues with unauthenticated remote code execution. Organisations should identify PHP deployments now and prepare to update promptly when fixes become available.
items.title: [Advisory] PHP2Shell: Critical Security Updates - Patch Now

items.summary: Progress Software has disclosed numerous security vulnerabilities in its WS_FTP Server file transfer software for Windows, including a maximum-severity improper authentication vulnerability. This flaw lets unauthenticated remote attackers obtain sensitive information, including administrative credentials. Other vulnerabilities, including OS command injection, path traversal and missing authorization, can lead to arbitrary command execution and full compromise of the underlying server.
items.title: [Advisory] Progress WS_FTP Server: Critical authentication vulnerability ( CVE-2026-84295 )

items.summary: A critical security vulnerability has been identified in the Linux kernel's IPv4 TCP subsystem that could allow remote attackers to achieve root-level code execution or cause a denial of service. While an AI-generated proof-of-concept specifically targeted servers with a multipath TCP (MPTCP) listener, it remains unconfirmed if systems without MPTCP enabled are similarly exploitable. Due to differing assessments of the attack complexity, major Linux distributions and the upstream kernel maintainers currently provide conflicting severity ratings for this flaw.
items.title: [Advisory] Linux Kernel: Critical RCE via TCP Flaw (CVE-2026-98432)

items.summary: A critical access bypass vulnerability has been disclosed in Drupal's Commerce Core module, which adds e-commerce features to Drupal websites. The module insufficiently protects certain routes and entity fields, allowing unauthenticated attackers to bypass access controls regardless of configuration and potentially financially impact online store vendors. The flaw is being actively exploited in the wild, and site owners are urged to audit their orders for inconsistencies.
items.title: [Advisory] Drupal Commerce Core: Access Bypass Exploited in the Wild (CVE-2026-118539)

items.summary: A set of high-severity vulnerabilities has been disclosed in TeamViewer's remote access software, allowing malicious or compromised remote hosts to execute arbitrary code on the viewer's system during a session. Additional flaws enable out-of-bounds writes via crafted screen data or session recordings and local privilege escalation to root on affected platforms. Patches are available and no active exploitation has been reported.
items.title: [Advisory] TeamViewer: Multiple High Rated Vulnerabilities Patches Including RCE and LPE

items.summary: The Claude Code Extension of popular coding software Visual Studio Code (VSCode) got compromised on the 29th of October.
items.title: VSCode: Trojanized Claude Code Extension Plants an SSH Backdoor

items.summary: A series of critical security vulnerabilities has been disclosed in WatchGuard's Fireware OS and Windows VPN client, potentially allowing attackers to compromise the appliances. These flaws affect various configurations, including active Access Portals, SIP proxies, and clustered environments, providing a comprehensive toolkit for potential threat actors.
items.title: [Advisory] WatchGuard: Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities patched

items.summary: A critical out-of-bounds write vulnerability in Google's Brotli decoder has been disclosed, affecting numerous software products that bundle the compression library, including Node.js, Microsoft .NET, PowerShell, Visual Studio, and Python Brotli packages. Successful exploitation can corrupt memory, leak sensitive data, crash services, or allow unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code when crafted Brotli data reaches the decoder.
items.title: [Advisory] Google Brotli: Critical OOB Write Enables RCE (CVE-2026-111497)

items.summary: A critical integer overflow vulnerability in GitLab’s CI/CD regular-expression compiler can allow unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected servers. The flaw results from insufficient validation of specially crafted regular expressions in CI/CD configurations.
items.title: [Advisory] GitLab CE/EE: Critical RCE in Regex Compiler (CVE-2026-97229)

items.summary: Veeam has released security updates for multiple vulnerabilities in Veeam Backup & Replication, Veeam Agent for Linux and Veeam ONE.
items.title: [Advisory] Veeam Backup & Replication: CDP Authorization Bypass (CVE-2026-108142), Veeam ONE MFA Bypass (CVE-2026-107671)

items.summary: Fortinet has announced security hardening updates across multiple product lines to address critical and high-severity vulnerabilities. It is recommended to prioritize updating internet-facing devices, as rapid reverse-engineering and patch-diffing could accelerate exploit development.
items.title: [Advisory] Fortinet: Oct. 2026 Security Hardening Release for Multiple Products

items.summary: HPE has disclosed multiple maximum-severity vulnerabilities in its Aruba Networking ArubaOS (AOS) software, including remote code execution and authentication bypass flaws. Successful exploitation could allow attackers to execute arbitrary code or bypass authentication on affected systems. Patches are available.
items.title: [Advisory] HPE Aruba Networking ArubaOS: Max-Severity RCE and Auth Bypass

items.summary: A critical security vulnerability has been disclosed in Arista's VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) that allows an authenticated remote attacker to gain operator privileges and masquerade as a local superuser. Successful exploitation can compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and the data it manages.
items.title: [Advisory] Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator: Critical SQL Injection Actively Exploited (CVE-2026-114625)

items.summary: Cisco has released fixes for 34 vulnerabilities across multiple products including Expressway Series, Snort 3, Unified Communications, IOS XR, and Secure Client. The most serious is a critical flaw in Expressway's database service that could let remote attackers run commands as root on clustered devices. Critical out-of-bounds write and incorrect calculation issues in the Snort 3 inspection engine also affect a wide range of Cisco firewall and security products.
items.title: [Advisory] Cisco: Critical vulnerabilities affecting Expressway and Snort 3

items.summary: A critical vulnerability in Oracle Java’s JSSE component allows unauthenticated remote attackers to compromise affected Java and GraalVM deployments through network-accessible APIs. Successful exploitation can expose or modify critical application data.
items.title: [Advisory] Oracle Java: Remote Data Compromise (CVE-2026-91403)

items.summary: A critical vulnerability has been disclosed in GitLab Community Edition (CE) and Enterprise Edition (EE) that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on self-managed GitLab servers. The same patch release also fixes several high, medium, and low severity issues, including an account takeover flaw and an OAuth/OIDC cache poisoning flaw.
items.title: [Advisory] GitLab CE/EE: Critical Unauthenticated RCE in Regex Compiler (CVE-2026-110264)

items.summary: An origin-validation vulnerability in BeyondTrust Remote Support allows unauthenticated remote attackers to perform arbitrary file operations on affected appliances. The flaw has been exploited as a zero-day to establish persistence, obtain root access, steal credentials, and pivot into internal environments.
items.title: [Advisory] BeyondTrust Remote Support: Arbitrary File Upload Enables Takeover (CVE-2026-102764)

items.summary: A critical flaw in Drupal core's Field UI module could let attackers execute arbitrary code on the web server. according to Drupal Security Team: The vulnerability is not directly exploitable with core alone, but multiple serious exploit paths exist with contributed modules.
items.title: [Advisory] Drupal Core: Critical Field UI Remote Code Execution (CVE-2026-108097)

items.summary: A critical vulnerability in Cisco Secure Email Gateway allows unauthenticated remote attackers to write arbitrary files by sending emails with crafted attachments. Successful exploitation enables command execution with root privileges, potentially resulting in complete appliance compromise.
items.title: [Advisory] Cisco Secure Email Gateway: Unauthenticated Root Command Execution in File Reputation service feature (CVE-2026-76519)

items.summary: A Remote Code Execution vulnerability in the PAN-OS management interface allows authenticated network attackers to execute arbitrary code with root privileges. Limited active exploitation has been observed, and security updates are available.
items.title: [Advisory] Palo Alto PAN-OS: Authenticated Remote Code Execution via Management Interface (CVE-2026-0322)

items.summary: In its monthly security update for October 2026, Microsoft published fixes for about 1'400 vulnerabilities across its software portfolio. The updates address numerous critical vulnerabilities, including an actively exploited Security Feature bypass, multiple Outlook vulnerabilities allowing an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network, some of which will trigger by viewing a malicious message in the Reading Pane as Elevation of Privileges and Remote Code Execution affecting Sharepoint.
items.title: [Advisory] Microsoft Patch Tuesday October 2026

items.summary: Adobe has released security updates addressing critical vulnerabilities across several enterprise products, including ColdFusion, Commerce, and Experience Manager. The most severe flaws lead to remote code execution and privilege escalation without requiring user interaction. If exploited, attackers could gain unauthorized elevated access or completely compromise vulnerable server deployments.
items.title: [Advisory] Adobe oct. 26 monthly patch  adresses multiple critical Vulnerabilities (Adobe Commerce / Adobe Experience Manager / ColdFusion)

items.summary: Citrix has disclosed multiple XenServer vulnerabilities affecting isolation between guest virtual machines and their hosts. Three flaws could allow privileged guest users to compromise or crash the host, while another permits unprivileged users to crash their own guest VM.
items.title: [Advisory] Citrix XenServer: Multiple vulnerabilities allow privileged user in a guest VM to compromise or crash the host (CVE-2026-79610 , CVE-2026-102700, CVE-2026-102701)

items.summary: A high-severity vulnerability in Ivanti Connect Secure allows remote, unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands. Attackers have chained it with an unpatched privilege-escalation flaw to gain root access, steal credentials, and exfiltrate data.
items.title: [Advisory] Ivanti Connect Secure: Authentication bypass leading to RCE  (CVE-2026-104935) and privilege escalation actively exploited as zero-days

items.summary: SonicWall has disclosed multiple vulnerabilities in its Secure Mobile Access (SMA) 1000 Series appliances. The most severe is a critical pre-authentication Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) flaw in the Work Place interface, allowing unauthenticated attackers to abuse the appliance as a proxy to reach internal functionality and perform unauthorized operations. Further flaws allow authenticated users with High privileges to achieve remote code execution through OS command injection and Zip Slip path traversal, and to store malicious JavaScript in the management console.
items.title: [Advisory] SonicWall SMA1000: unauthenticated SSRF (CVE-2026-102255)

items.summary: A critical security flaw has been disclosed in multiple Atlassian Data Center and Server products that allows unauthorized access to sensitive application data. By exploiting a path traversal vulnerability, an unauthenticated attacker can read specific files located within the web application root directory.
items.title: [Advisory] Atlassian: Critical unauthenticated Arbitrary File Read (CVE-2026-21589)

items.summary: A critical zero-day vulnerability has been disclosed in PaperCut NG and PaperCut MF print management software that is being actively exploited in attacks. The flaw resides in the Application Server and can be triggered against internet-facing installations, leading to potential system compromise.
items.title: [Advisory] PaperCut NG/MF: Actively Exploited Zero-Day Vulnerability (CVE-2026-82078, CVE-2026-81578)

items.summary: Multiple critical security vulnerabilities have been disclosed in Cisco License On-Prem and Cisco Nexus switches, potentially allowing attackers to bypass authentication, forge cryptographic signatures, or execute arbitrary code. If successfully exploited, these flaws could lead to unauthenticated root access or denial-of-service conditions, severely impacting network infrastructure security.
items.title: [Advisory] Cisco Nexus Switches and License On-Prem: Multiple Critical RCE Vulnerabilities

items.summary: A critical security flaw has been addressed in Veeam Backup & Replication that could allow unauthorized execution of malicious code on the backup server. Additional vulnerabilities were also resolved, which could lead to arbitrary file reads, unauthorized data modification, and cross-site scripting attacks.
items.title: [Advisory] Veeam Backup & Replication: Critical Remote Code Execution (CVE-2025-64393)

items.summary: A memory overflow vulnerability has been disclosed in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway appliances configured for SAML authentication. It could allow unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service. Cloud Software Group urges to upgrade affected customer-managed instances.
items.title: [Advisory] Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway: Memory Overflow vulnerability leads to RCE/DoS (CVE-2026-107406)

items.summary: Multiple vulnerabilities have been resolved in the open-source learning management system ILIAS, including several remote code execution (RCE) flaws. One notable flaw lets anonymous users download protected file objects without permission when the public area is enabled. Other fixes cover stored XSS, broken access control, path traversal file deletion and unauthenticated user enumeration.
items.title: [Advisory] ILIAS: Multiple Critical RCE and Access Control Flaws

items.summary: A high-severity memory overflow vulnerability in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway has been exploited in targeted attacks, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service condition. The flaw only affects deployments configured to use SAML authentication as a service provider or identity provider; repeated exploitation can render the service unavailable.
items.title: [Advisory] Citrix NetScaler: Memory Overflow DoS Exploited (CVE-2026-88779)

items.summary: Critical zero-day vulnerabilities have been disclosed in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway appliances that allow unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 were being actively exploited in the wild before the patch was released.
items.title: [Advisory] Citrix NetScaler: RCE CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 Actively Exploited as Zero-Days
